description_ko: 대검의 검날이 저울 기둥이 되고 별 가드의 회전축에 기울어진 저울팔을 결합했다. 몸 앞의 큰 두 접시와 추로 저울의 기능과 무게 차이를 드러낸다.

references.role: Sole exact edit target: user's preferred gargoyle face, blindfold, carved mane, heavy crouched body, armor, wings and art style retained; only original sword/scales integration redesigned

visual_qa.identity: Selected roaring gargoyle face, gold blindfold, carved curl mane, broad ivory/navy/brass star armor, crouched body, two bent legs and two slab wings retained. Sword arm reposed to hold upper handle; other large claw remains planted.
visual_qa.scale_readability: One vertical ground-planted sword blade is the central support. Its large star bearing/indicator pivots one clearly tilted beam. Exactly two deep chain-hung pans are prominent in the foreground: nearer low pan holds one large stone weight, higher pan is empty. Pivot, beam, slings and pans form one readable balance at thumbnail size.
visual_qa.equipment_and_anatomy: One sword only; original diagonal sword and both old wing-tip pans were removed. Two original arms and two legs, single head, exactly two total weighing pans. The grip and fulcrum are distinct.
visual_qa.framing: Entire figure, sword point, wing tips and both large pans contained. Upper wing and lower feet have close margins, with no required framing correction.
visual_qa.file_validation: Saved PNG decoded with System.Drawing at1536x1024 and SHA256 recorded. Generated output visually inspected; saved copy hash verified.
